description.en: Shonisaurus popularis: whole living environment prop. Nominal whole length 1m ART SETTING. Kelley 2022 Smithsonian scientific outline anchors long deep torso, narrow rostrum, four paddles and long low-dorsal-lobed tail. NHMU Irmis supports toothed jaws, not exact tooth count. Pose, transverse body thickness, paddle soft tissue, colour, eye placement and tooth hints are artistic. No preserved skin or scan accuracy claim; no tall dolphin dorsal fin.
